AnyNode.description: Comprehensive union representing any valid node (built-in or custom).

BoxModel.description: The standard CSS box model properties supported by the rendering engine. Maps closely to standard CSS styling.

BuiltInNode.description: Union of all native PaperCast nodes.

DataBinding.description: Configuration for binding dynamic values (e.g. JSON data variables, arrays) into node properties or layouts.

DocumentSchema.description: Represents the entire state of a PaperCast document, including its hierarchy, widget definitions, theme configuration, static data, and metadata.

NodeConfig.description: The foundational shape of every node in the PaperCast AST.
